changelog.summary: Scaffolded — 7 domains, index.json grounded in the official CCAR-P Exam Guide (v1.0, effective July 2026)
Updated D1 notes: full Solution Design & Architecture content — patterns, multi-agent orchestration, decomposition, business value pillars, Deep Dive
Added 20 questions to domain D1 (Solution Design & Architecture)
Domain 2 notes added.
Added 16 questions to domain D2 (Claude Models, Prompting & Context Engineering)
Domain 3 notes added.
Added 23 questions to domain D3 (Integration)
Domain 4 notes added.
Domain 4: 19 questions added.
Domain 5 notes added.
Added 17 questions to domain D5 (Governance, Safety & Risk Management)
Domain 6 notes added.
Added 17 questions to domain D6 (Stakeholder Communication & Lifecycle Management)
Domain 7 notes added.
Added 8 questions to domain D7 (Developer Productivity & Operational Enablement)

Added 6 scenarios: RAG pipeline design, multi-agent least-privilege, cost/latency optimization, production evaluation & A/B testing, regulated-industry governance rollout, and Claude Code developer enablement

D7 gap-fill: added 4 questions (ccap-d7-009..012 — hooks, cost/token monitoring, productivity-impact measurement, MCP version rollout risk) closing the domain below the platform's ≥10/domain minimum (8→12). Backfilled `difficulty` (easy/medium/hard) on all 124 questions across all 7 domains (previously 0% coverage). Added ≥1 content-type + ≥1 cognitive-level tag from the platform's controlled taxonomy to every question, additive to existing descriptive tags.

Extracted the embedded 'Worked scenario' prose from all 7 domain notes files into 7 dedicated RichScenario v2.0 files (ccap-scenario-007..013), each with 4 scenario-specific questions and keyLearnings, matching the platform's scenarios/ convention. Notes files now link out to Scenario Practice instead of duplicating the walkthrough inline.

Added taxonomyIds to 7 domain(s) — cross-vertical relationship discovery metadata (IDEA-0008 Phase 4), aggregated + alias-resolved from each domain's own question tags. No question/notes/scenario content changed.

Replaced 5 diagram PNGs in d1–d2 notes with AaryaAI-branded SVGs (feedback loop, architecture patterns, orchestrator + subagents, prompt caching, context window budget) with descriptive alt text; switched references to absolute /content paths; old PNGs removed.

Syllabus and fact refresh. Exam guide v1.0 (July 2026) unchanged: domains, weights and objectives already matched. Remapped 13 existing questions to the objectives they test (3.6, 3.8 and 4.2 had none mapped; 2.5 and 6.5 had one). Added 15 questions (d1-021..022, d2-017..020, d3-024..025, d4-020..021, d5-018..019, d6-018, d7-013..014) on effort/adaptive thinking, Skills loading, caching minimums, few-shot diversity, tool search, eval design, stop_reason monitoring, knowledge cutoff, counterfactual bias tests, decomposition patterns, value framing, model deprecation, --bare CI runs and settings precedence; every official objective now has at least 3 mapped questions. Rewrote d2-003 and d3-007 and two options of d2-009 (extended thinking budget_tokens is rejected on Claude 4.7+, effort replaces it; d2-009 now matches the 3-5 example guidance), updated d7-002 and d7-004 (managed settings sources; commands merged into skills), and noted on 6 temperature distractors that Claude 4.7+ accepts only default sampling values. Notes: current model lineup and effort (D2), caching/Skills facts (D2), tool-selection threshold and tool search (D3), batch pricing, effort tuning and removed temperature fix (D4), model deprecation (D6), settings precedence, skills and --bare (D7). 3 scenarios updated for the same facts. Scenario correct-answer positions rebalanced (B had been correct in 87%); ccap-d7-012 options rebalanced so the answer isn't the conspicuously long one.
